bibliographic.abstract: We report on the polarized neutron reflectometry investigation of monolayer of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles assembled by the Langmuir-Schaefer method. After deposition onto a solid substrate the polarized neutron reflectometry measurements in the external magnetic field were carried out. Thickness, density, roughness and in-depth resolved magnetization profile of the resulted layer were obtained from accurate fitting routine.

samples.sample_description: Assembled by the Langmuir-Schaefer method on a solid substrate. Composed of 10 nm diameter nanoparticles with a mean lattice constant of 12 nm, laterally organized in hexagonal polycrystal. Consists of pure maghemite.

datasets.dataset_description: Measurements carried out on neutron reflectometer Super ADAM using monochromatic neutron beam with wavelength 5.18 Å and polarization P0 = 99.8% at room temperature in external magnetic field B = 500 mT applied parallel or anti-parallel to the vector of incoming neutron polarization.
